name: Elune's Blessing gives Hand of Elune 30% more of your bonus healing (#1341)
contract: Elune's Blessing 681407 (SpellFamilyName 32, passive Attributes 0x40) reads "Your Hand of Elune now gains an additional $s1% of your bonus healing". Its effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 24 = SPELLMOD_BONUS_MULTIPLIER, EffectBasePoints 29 with DieSides 1 resolving to +30, and EffectSpellClassMask word1 0x40000, which selects Hand of Elune 801990 (SpellFamilyFlags word1 0x40000, SpellLevel 16, MaxLevel 0 so Unit::CalculateLevelPenalty returns 1.0). Native path: Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone multiplies DoneAdvertisedBenefit by coeff after ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_BONUS_MULTIPLIER, coeff*100), so the flat +30 becomes +0.30 of bonus healing on top of the coefficient the spell already has (rev_20260909_06_starcaller_completion.sql gives 801990 a spell_bonus_data row of 0 direct_bonus; the module's own healing term is added separately inside ModifySpellEffectBaseValue and does not pass through this function). The metric spell_healing_done calls Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone with a fixed base of 1000, so the difference between a talented and an untalented fixture is 0.30 * DoneAdvertisedBenefit. Both fixtures receive the same fixture bonus healing from set_aura QA Test +1000 SP 10030 (SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_SPELL_POWER_FLAT 345, EffectMiscValue 127, EffectBasePoints 999 resolving to 1000, read by Unit::SpellBaseHealingBonusDone for every school), so the expected difference is 300; the window 295..360 allows for a small identical base of other spell power that the level-80 fixtures might carry. Bonus healing of 0 would give a difference of 0, which is why the fixture aura is needed.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Fixture 1000 bonus healing on the control
Fixture 1000 bonus healing on the talented healer
Hand of Elune healing without the talent
With the talent Hand of Elune gains 30% of the 1000 bonus healing
